question: What was the 1974 Saudi arrangement and what remains of it?
start: GAO EMD-79-45, 11 June 1979: Treasury gave Saudi Arabia an add-on purchase window in 1974 and kept its holdings confidential (EXAM_T9 links L1 and L2)

links.claim: In 1974 the US Treasury gave Saudi Arabia a non-auction add-on purchase window as part of a bilateral financial package and kept Saudi holdings inside a regional total. The window was opened to all official buyers in 1975

evidence.what: GAO audit, chapter 3, as read in EXAM_T9

links.claim: The secrecy ended on 16 May 2016 when Treasury published Saudi holdings, 116.8 billion for March 2016

evidence.what: CNBC report of the first release

links.claim: In November 2025 the US and Saudi Arabia signed a public Strategic Defense Agreement, named Saudi Arabia a major non-NATO ally, and the Crown Prince raised Saudi investment commitments to nearly 1 trillion dollars into US infrastructure, technology and industry

actor.name: Executive Office of the President of the United States

links.claim: What remains is an open security-for-investment exchange aimed at real assets and arms, not a duty to hold Treasuries. Saudi Treasuries move with oil and budgets (minus 59 billion in early 2020, 160.4 to 141.2 billion from February to August 2026 during the Hormuz crisis)
footprints_expected: A holding floor would show as Saudi Treasuries holding steady in stress months
Public commitments would name Treasuries if they were part of the bargain
A side letter would leak or be cited in Congress

footprints_found.what: TIC: Saudi holdings fell about 59bn in February to April 2020 and from 160.4 to 141.2bn in February to August 2026
White House fact sheet names infrastructure, technology, industry, arms and nuclear, not Treasuries

footprints_missing: No document of a Treasury-holding clause after 1975 found (EXAM_T9 and one search here)
rivals: An unwritten understanding on reserve currency (keep the peg and dollar pricing) survives beside the public deal, graded I2 in EXAM_T9 at 55%
The 1 trillion figure is mostly a relabel of existing plans, so even the public exchange is thinner than stated
links.reveal: Release of the July 1974 Simon cables (no date). Monthly TIC through 2027: a fall below 100 billion with no oil shock would show active diversification

rival_hypotheses.text: Saudi Arabia holds Treasuries for safety and the peg, and invests for returns
A standing secret deal still obliges Saudi dollar recycling into Treasuries
Both sides want security and dollar assets. The public 2025 deal states the trade openly
The 50-year treaty story is a misreading of the public 1974 Joint Commission

coordination.channel: For 1974 to 2016: US Treasury, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and SAMA through the add-on window and TIC reporting. Today the exchange is public (White House fact sheet), not deniable
coordination.enforcement: Saudi money would not come without the confidentiality pledge. The US security guarantee and arms sales on the other side
coordination.secrecy_load: A handful of Treasury and New York Fed officials for 41 years (1974 to 2016), with GAO and Congress partly aware from 1979
